title: Richard Hipp - Git: Just Say No
summary: SQLite author Richard Hipp's talk at SouthEast LinuxFest criticizing Git's workflow and introducing Fossil as an alternative. He lists Git enhancements and argues for keeping history intact.
why: Recommended for the SQLite author's reasoned case for a different approach to version control, and as an introduction to Fossil.

quote.text: If the author of SQLite advances some arguments around the proper way of doing version management, I would advise to error on the side of caution and listen at least a second time.
